issue.title: GitHub CLI / REST API PATCH returns HTTP 200 but ignores pull request body update
issue.body:
Hello,

I am reporting a reproducible HTTP 200 no-op behavior while updating the body of a pull request through GitHub CLI and the GitHub REST API.

Repository:
https://github.com/mradali4554/LeanStandardWorkOS

Pull request:
https://github.com/mradali4554/LeanStandardWorkOS/pull/6

Environment:
- GitHub CLI: 2.101.0
- GitHub CLI binary SHA-256: df05089117a23889b3f6ea08d7644849afe7b6025647a09f33b45c71f1418f75
- Operating system: Windows 11 Enterprise, AMD64
- PowerShell: 5.1.26100.9711
- Authenticated account: mradali4554
- Repository relationship: owner

Request:
- Method: PATCH
- Endpoint: /repos/mradali4554/LeanStandardWorkOS/pulls/6
- Accept: application/vnd.github+json
- X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28
- GitHub request ID: F2B8:3B8F9A:7D05582:BB41B3A:6AD08F77
- Request time: 2026-10-15T08:31:51Z

The input was a temporary ASCII-only JSON file containing exactly one top-level property named `body`.

Payload verification:
- Payload size: 6,821 bytes
- Bytes greater than 0x7F: 0
- BOM: absent
- JSON parsing: successful
- Parsed body matched the intended Unicode body exactly
- Parsed body SHA-256: c284155fd3ea6b36cca3e27d9e556dc1927238e8ba995d2520c3bfdf53574614
- Parsed body character length: 5,666
- Parsed body UTF-8 byte count: 5,880

Observed behavior:
1. The command exited with code 0 and returned HTTP 200 OK.
2. The response included request ID F2B8:3B8F9A:7D05582:BB41B3A:6AD08F77.
3. The response JSON contained the pre-existing pull request body rather than the reques

The original operation was a direct `gh api` REST request, not a `gh pr edit` invocation.

## Exact command used

The exact command was:

```powershell

  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" `
  -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" `
  --include `
  repos/mradali4554/LeanStandardWorkOS/pulls/6 `
  --input "<temporary-ascii-only-json-payload-file>"
```
